prop-sunrise: Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM on all floors.
Visitors need an approved pass before check-in at the gate.
Smoking is not allowed in rooms, corridors, or the terrace.
Housekeeping visits rooms between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on weekdays.
Common-area dishes and study tables should be left clear after use.
prop-greenview: Quiet hours are 10:30 PM to 6:00 AM.
Visitor hours end at 8:00 PM unless a gate pass is approved.
Cooking appliances are not allowed in rooms.
Mess timings are posted weekly on the dining-hall board.
Bicycles must be parked in the North Block rack only.
